motivation.focus: A funded run exposed a diagnostic blind spot. Free re-probes showed normal Tab traversal into browser chrome was mistaken for missing keyboard controls; this candidate reports that state rather than changing application focus.
motivation.verification: Blinded review identified weaker verification coverage. Generic guidance now chooses tests by risk instead of unconditionally minimizing their count. Prompt causation is a hypothesis, not established.

features: Read-only optional focus metadata: document focus, active-element kind, bounded tag/type/tabIndex, and a ref only when retained in the current observation.
Absent metadata from older backends remains unknown. Observing never focuses a control or brings a page forward; metadata contains no field values or page text.
Generic GPT guidance favors focused changes, critical invariants and relevant failure/race verification without duplicating equivalent checks.

validation.check: Node policy and real TCP-reset controls

realBrowserCoverage: Focused input metadata and current refs
Bounded inventory omits an unretained focused ref
Tab leaves the document with body active and document focus false, then re-enters the first input
limits: Two changes are bundled; a future paired result cannot isolate their individual effects.
